name: Human Witch (CR 2)
body:
HUMAN WITCH
CR 2

XP 600
Female human witch 3
CG Medium humanoid (human)
Init +1; Senses Perception +1

DEFENSE

AC 11, touch 11, flat-footed 10 (+1 Dex)
hp 19 (3d6+6)
Fort +3, Ref +3, Will +5

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee mwk dagger +1 (1d4–1/19–20)
Special Attacks hexes (cackle, charm [1 step, 2 rounds])
Witch Spells Prepared (CL 3rd; concentration +5)

2nd—detect thoughts (DC 14), glitterdust (DC 14)
1st—charm person (DC 13), hypnotism (DC 13), mage armor
0th (at will)—dancing lights, light, mending, message

Patron Trickery

STATISTICS

Str 8, Dex 12, Con 12, Int 15, Wis 13, Cha 14
Base Atk +1; CMB +0; CMD 11
Feats Combat Casting, Deceitful, Eschew Materials
Skills Bluff +7, Disguise +5, Profession (barkeep) +6, Sleight of Hand +2, Spellcraft +8, Stealth +3, Use Magic Device +8
Languages Common, Dwarven, Elven, +1 additional
SQ witch’s familiar (cat)
Combat Gear potion of cure moderate wounds, scroll of burning hands, acid (2); Other Gear mwk dagger, cloak of resistance +1, key to area 12, journal key (see page 45), 3 gp
